# nullplatform_accounts (Data Source)

Lists every account of an organization. Pair it with `nullplatform_namespaces` to walk the organization's account and namespace tree, e.g. to configure providers for each namespace in bulk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nullplatform = {
      source = "nullplatform/nullplatform"
    }
  }
}

provider "nullplatform" {}

# Every account of the provider credentials' organization
data "nullplatform_accounts" "all" {}

# Every account of an explicit organization
data "nullplatform_accounts" "other_org" {
  organization_id = 1234567890
}

output "account_slugs" {
  value = [for acc in data.nullplatform_accounts.all.accounts : acc.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organization_id` (Number) ID of the organization whose accounts are listed. Defaults to the organization of the provider's credentials.

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (List of Object) Every account of the organization, ordered by ID. Deleted accounts are not listed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `nrn` (String)
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `repository_prefix` (String)
- `repository_provider` (String)
- `settings` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `status` (String)
